en.name: Peanuts, shelled
en.summary: Shelled peanuts keep 4 weeks from purchase in the cupboard, 12 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 24 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Peanuts in the shell keep far longer at room temperature, which tells you exactly what the shell is doing.
en.pantry: 4 weeks from purchase in an airtight jar, cool, dark and away from the hob. Once the shell is off, the peanut's oil is exposed to air, and oxidation — not bacteria — is what runs the clock. Damp is the other risk worth naming: peanuts stored warm and humid are the classic home for mould, so keep the jar genuinely dry, discard any nut that is shrivelled, discoloured or tastes bitter, and do not try to sort the good from the bad in a batch that smells musty.
en.fridge: 12 months from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, sealed. Cold is the real answer for shelled peanuts: it takes them from a month to a year, because low temperature slows the oxidation of the fat by a large factor and keeps the jar too dry and too cold for mould. Use an airtight container rather than the bag they came in, and keep them away from strongly smelling foods.
en.freezer: 24 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Peanuts hold very little water, so freezing does nothing to the texture and they can be chopped or blitzed straight from frozen. Freeze them in a bag with the air pressed out, or in a rigid box, and portion the bag so you are not thawing a kilo to get a handful.
en.thawing: No thawing required. Let the sealed bag come back to room temperature before opening it so condensation does not settle on the nuts.
spoilage: A bitter, sharp taste — rancid oil, and one nut is enough to tell.
Shrivelled, discoloured or visibly mouldy kernels.
A musty, damp-cellar smell from the jar.
Soft, chewy peanuts instead of crisp ones, meaning moisture has got in.
tips: Buy shelled peanuts in the quantity you will use within the month, or plan to chill them.
Keep them dry above all else; damp warm storage is what lets mould in.
Freeze the bulk and keep a working jar in the fridge.
Discard the whole batch if it smells musty rather than picking out the bad nuts.

faq.q: How long do shelled peanuts keep?
faq.a: 4 weeks from purchase in the cupboard, 12 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 24 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Should peanuts be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: Shelled ones, yes, unless you will finish them within the month. The fridge takes them from 4 weeks to a year.

faq.q: How can you tell if peanuts have gone bad?
faq.a: Taste one: rancid peanuts are bitter and oily. A musty smell, shrivelled kernels or any visible mould means the batch goes.

zh.name: 花生仁（去殼）
zh.summary: 去殼花生自購買日起，放櫥櫃 4 週，4 °C 以下冷藏 12 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 24 個月。帶殼花生在常溫下能放久得多，這就明白告訴你殼在做什麼事了。
zh.pantry: 氣密罐、陰涼、避光、遠離爐台，自購買日起 4 週。殼一剝掉，花生的油脂就暴露在空氣中，在倒數的是氧化而不是細菌。另一個值得點名的風險是受潮：又熱又濕存放的花生，是發霉的典型溫床。請確保罐子真的乾燥，遇到乾癟、變色或嚐起來苦的就丟掉；如果整批聞起來有霉味，不要試著挑好的出來吃。
zh.fridge: 密封放 4 °C 以下，自購買日起 12 個月。對去殼花生來說，低溫才是真正的答案：它把一個月變成一年，因為低溫大幅拖慢油脂氧化，也讓罐子裡又乾又冷、不適合霉菌。請用氣密容器而不是原本的袋子，並且遠離味道重的食物。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下，自購買日起 24 個月。花生含水極少，冷凍完全不影響口感，要切碎或打碎都可以直接從冷凍取用。請壓出空氣密封裝袋或用硬盒，並且分裝，免得為了一把而解凍一公斤。
zh.thawing: 不需要解凍。請讓密封袋回到室溫再打開，避免水氣凝在花生上。
spoilage: 嚐起來苦而尖銳——那是油耗，吃一顆就夠判斷。
乾癟、變色，或明顯長霉的花生仁。
罐子裡飄出潮濕地窖般的霉味。
咬起來軟韌而不脆，代表水氣跑進去了。
tips: 去殼花生請買一個月內用得完的量，否則就準備冰起來。
最要緊的是保持乾燥；又濕又熱的存放正是霉菌的機會。
大量冷凍，冷藏留一小罐日常取用。
整批有霉味就整批丟，不要挑掉壞的繼續吃。

faq.a: 自購買日起，放櫥櫃 4 週，4 °C 以下冷藏 12 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 24 個月。
去殼的花生，除非一個月內吃完，否則要。冷藏能把 4 週變成一年。
吃一顆：油耗的花生又苦又油。有霉味、果仁乾癟或看得到霉，整批就該丟。
